needs_human.note: A request is retired by whichever shell takes it, even when the requested tab is not listed in that shell at that moment, so the request is dropped. Before the fix, an unlisted target was not applied later either, because the effect is keyed on seq. Behaviour is unchanged, but the retire step now makes the drop permanent.; A `tabRequest` made while no shell is mounted (for example a find request on a phone with the sheet at peek) still lingers until a shell mounts. It is not reset on a file change, so it could be applied on the next file's first shell if that tab id is listed there. Not traced through find's own open/close handling.
The sheet's state after select() when it starts at full is not covered by I11 as written; the code keeps it at full.
